statements: 76% of it is raw fact. Only 14% is conclusion.
4 of its 9 districts carry nothing above ground level — including the largest, which has 143 facts and no conclusions drawn from them.
One district is inverted: mind is 48 nodes of pure conclusion resting on no ground of its own.
58% of its arguments cross a district line, so it is more interconnected than compartmented.
It contradicts itself in 11 places, and those contradictions are kept rather than resolved away.
Its thinnest district, health, holds 2 nodes. Its densest, mind, averages 28.0 arguments per node.
self.method: VOLUME = share of nodes vs largest district. LIFT = share of the district that is conclusion, not raw fact. BUILT = geometric mean of the two.
